description: This file defines a WearableListenerService that handles DataItem changes and Message events from the Android Wearable Data Layer API. It processes incoming data events, connects to GoogleApiClient, and initiates actions like starting activities based on received messages.

classes.name: DataLayerListenerService
classes.description: A service that listens for DataItems and Messages on the wearable data layer, handling data changes and message reception for inter-device communication.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and connects it when the service is created.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming DataEvents, connects GoogleApiClient if necessary, and processes data items based on their URI path, sending messages to the originating node.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming MessageEvents, starting MainActivity if the message path matches START_ACTIVITY_PATH.

methods.name: LOGD
methods.description: Logs debug messages if logging at DEBUG level is enabled.
